en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a tree‑lined avenue with wooden and brick buildings on both sides. In the distance a horse‑drawn vehicle and a few pedestrians can be seen. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Östergatan in Vänersborg. A sign on the left reads "Elia Kapellet" on a wooden building, and at the lower right the publisher credit appears.
